# Stratus Creative

> A creative studio building websites, workflows, and online presence for businesses that want to look bigger than they are. Productized starter websites, custom AI workflows, and transparent pricing.

Stratus Creative is a boutique creative agency based in Simpsonville, SC, working with clients across North America. We specialize in three things: websites, workflow automation (including AI agents and tools), and online presence (Google Business Profile, reputation management).

Our differentiators:
- One flat-priced productized website tier ($1,495) and one custom-quoted tier (from $5,000) — no SaaS-style tier ladders
- Transparent pricing on AI workflows — build fee + monthly Care + pass-through API costs are always shown separately
- Free public AI workflow cost estimator at https://stratus-creative.com/tools/cost-estimator
- Built on modern Next.js + Vercel infrastructure
- AI-native development workflow

## Core pages

- [Home](https://stratus-creative.com/): brand overview and three-pillar positioning
- [Services](https://stratus-creative.com/services): deep dive on websites, workflows, online presence

- [AI Workflow Cost Estimator](https://stratus-creative.com/tools/cost-estimator): free interactive tool to estimate the monthly cost of an AI workflow (LLM API + third-party APIs + Care fee)
- [Work](https://stratus-creative.com/work): in-flight projects and case studies
- [Start a project](https://stratus-creative.com/start): contact form to begin a discovery conversation
- [Support](https://stratus-creative.com/support): existing-client support and FAQ

## Pricing summary

### Websites
- Starter (productized, self-serve): $1,495 flat, ships in 5–7 business days
- Custom (scoped engagement): from $5,000

### Typical engagement ranges (custom work)
- Multi-page marketing or brand site: $4K – $8K, 3–5 weeks
- Brand system + multi-page site: $7K – $14K, 5–8 weeks
- Process automation project: $3K – $8K, 2–4 weeks
- AI tools, agents, or chatbots: $5K – $15K build, ongoing AI Care ($199–$899/mo) + pass-through API costs

### Hosting & maintenance
- Basic hosting (Vercel managed): $49/month
- Hosting + monthly content updates: $99/month

### AI Workflow Care tiers
- Light: $199/month (up to 3 hrs care, light volume single-purpose AI)
- Standard: $399/month (up to 6 hrs care, multi-step workflows with memory)
- Pro: $899/month (up to 12 hrs care, voice agents and complex multi-agent systems)

### Online presence
- Google Business Profile setup: $250 one-time
- Reputation & reviews management: $149/month

## How AI workflows are priced

Every AI workflow quote breaks into three explicit components:
1. Build fee (one-time): the engineering work to design, build, test, and deploy
2. AI Care (recurring): Stratus's monitoring, prompt tuning, model upgrades, and small fixes
3. API costs (recurring, pass-through): LLM tokens, third-party APIs, vector storage. Client uses own API keys, or Stratus manages keys and bills cost + 15% admin

API cost ranges by workflow type:
- Light (FAQ bot, email triage): $0–$50/month
- Moderate (support bot, quote engine): $50–$500/month
- Heavy (voice agents, real-time): $500+/month
